rows.prompt: Explain why the sky appears blue in two sentences.
rows.response: The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called scattering, in which shorter blue light waves are dispersed in all directions by the tiny molecules of nitrogen and oxygen in the Earth's atmosphere. This scattering effect makes blue light appear more prominent than other colors of light, resulting in the blue color we see when we look at the sky.
